storageIntro: We store the following user data:
storedEmail: Email address (for authentication and account recovery)
storedTokens: Encrypted OAuth tokens (for connected services like GitHub)
storedGithub: Linked GitHub account ID (to preserve your login)
usageDashboard: User data is used strictly to provide the dashboard features and widget functionalities.
usageTokens: OAuth tokens are used solely to fetch data for the connected services as configured by the user.
noSale: We do not sell your data.
youtubePrivacy: YouTube widgets load thumbnails from i.ytimg.com and, when you click Play, the video player from youtube-nocookie.com. These requests send your IP address and browser information to Google / YouTube, under their privacy policy.
adminPrivacy: Administrators see each account's name, email, role, email verification, ban state and registration date, to manage accounts (role, ban, sign-out, deletion). They never see passwords, API keys, OAuth tokens or widget settings.
profilePolicy: You can edit your display name and email, including with a GitHub-only account. Your GitHub account ID keeps your login linked to the same Dashboard account after an email change.
registrationPolicy: New accounts require accepting the terms and confirming that you are at least 16, including when signing up with GitHub. This is a self-declaration; we do not collect or verify your birth date.
accessDetails: : "Download My Data" exports your profile, readable widget configurations and connected-service metadata. Password hashes, API keys and OAuth tokens are excluded.
erasureDetails: : You can permanently delete your account, widgets and stored service credentials from the active database via "Delete My Account". This does not delete data held by external providers or retained backups.
consentDetails: : By registering, you accept our Terms of Service (CGU) and this Privacy Policy.
purpose: Dashboard lets you gather and organize widgets connected to different services. These terms define the rules for using the platform.
account: You must provide a valid email address and protect your password. A display name is optional. You are responsible for actions performed from your account.
acceptable: You agree not to misuse the service, attempt to access other users’ accounts, disrupt the platform or use integrations in ways that violate their own terms.
data: Information needed for accounts, preferences and widgets is stored to provide the service. Passwords are stored as hashes and are never kept in plain text.
external: Some features rely on third-party services. Their availability and the data processing they perform also depend on their own rules and policies.
availability: The platform may evolve, be interrupted for maintenance or experience outages. Continuous or error-free operation cannot be guaranteed.
deletion: You may request deletion of your account and its associated data. Contact details and the way to exercise this right will be set out in the privacy policy.
changes: These terms may be updated as the service evolves. Users will receive clear information about significant changes.
termsIntro: These terms explain the rules that apply when you create an account and use Dashboard.
acceptanceDetails: By checking the box during registration, you confirm you have read and accepted these terms. If you do not accept them, you must not create an account.
returnRegistration: Return to sign up to create your account.
